observations: Photo shows a wall-mounted/standing TV console unit with multiple open shelves/cubby spaces on the left and a large central TV screen area.
The TV screen appears powered off (dark/reflective) and there are visible cables hanging behind/near the left side.
There is also a separate top surface/center area that could be part of the console; no clear separate 'center table' is shown in this single photo.
No readable brand/model labels are visible on the TV or console in the photo.

claims.claim: Relocating. come carry this center table and TV console for 140k.
claims.evidence: Only one photo is provided and it clearly shows a TV console with a TV; a separate center table is not clearly visible.

claims.claim: TV console is included with the center table.
claims.evidence: Photo shows a TV console and TV, but does not clearly show a separate center table.

risks.risk: TV may not be working (screen off in photo; no power-on proof).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the TV turning on from standby and displaying a channel/menu (with sound).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as TV not confirmed working (worst case: treat as non-working/for parts) while still valuing the console as used.

risks.risk: TV size/model is unknown, which strongly affects resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV back label/spec sticker (brand + model + screen size) or a close-up of the model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest plausible TV size/value for used units, since exact size/model can’t be read.

risks.risk: Console condition issues (scratches, water damage, loose joints) are not assessable from this single angle.
risks.proof: Extra photos of all edges/corners and close-ups of the shelves/doors (top, bottom, and sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as average-wear used furniture with possible minor damage.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (mounting hardware, remote control, stand/base, cables).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out: remote, power cable, HDMI/AV cables, and any mounting brackets/bolts.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming remote/mounting accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: The 'center table' may not be included or may be different from what’s shown.
risks.proof: Photo showing the separate center table clearly (full view) and confirming it’s included in the same pickup.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as TV console only (worst case: center table not included).

proof_requests: Send a video of the TV powering on with sound (and ideally changing channels/input).
Send a close-up photo of the TV back label/spec sticker (brand, model, screen size).
Send full photos of the console from front, sides, top, and bottom to check damage/loose parts.
Confirm what’s included: remote, power cable, HDMI/AV cables, and any mounting hardware.
Show the 'center table' clearly (full view) if it’s truly included.
response.reason: From the photo, I can see a TV console with a TV, but the TV’s working status, exact size/model, and whether a separate center table is included are not provable. To price safely, I need power-on proof and the TV’s model/size label.
